source_panel: NGC 4579, bottom right of the 4 by 2 panel array
target_signal: approaching-versus-receding Halpha rotation parity beyond the independently fixed bar radius
extraction_policy: render page 43 at 600 dpi if marker separation requires it
identify every visually distinct source marker series and the source legend before assigning side labels
retain marker centers and graphically resolvable vertical errors without smoothing
do not reconstruct individual sides algebraically from the averaged numeric table
use the author numeric radius grid and averaged vrot only as axis/calibration cross-checks, not as side values
reverse-render every accepted marker on the original panel
quality_gates: two marker series are visually and semantically distinguishable
approaching/receding assignment is source-supported rather than guessed
each side has at least three post-bar markers
reverse render overlays accepted source markers
side parity is computed only on common or explicitly interpolable radial support
prefrozen_odd_law: orientation-odd sector only; no amplitude or radial-law fitting on NGC4579
claim_boundary: side-extraction protocol only; no orientation-odd time-channel value has been read or scored
